system.description:
Unit type. Discipline modifier +0. Key abilities: Awareness, Fighting, Marksmanship.

A small fleet that can carry another unit. Requires a domain with a coastline.

Training adds to the cost (p. 75): Green +1 (Discipline Challenging 9, 20 XP) · Trained +3 (Routine 6, 60 XP) · Veteran +5 (Easy 3, 100 XP) · Elite +7 (Automatic 0, 140 XP). A unit is 100 soldiers, 20 riders or 5 warships; raising an ability costs 20 XP.

Sword Chronicle p. 76
